mappings.position: unit array order; row-major fixed 4-column grid
mappings.integrity: one trace per run; intact=true, fractured=false, open diamond=null
mappings.latency: linear path horizontal extent, 0..series maximum rounded up to 5000 ms
mappings.throughput: floor(tokens_per_second / 10) pulses; pulses equally spaced on the trace
mappings.resource: mean observed memory_gb sets five-run envelope; 24 + 48 * GB / shared maximum
mappings.variance: run latency minus unit/condition median; displacement = 0.15 * lane spacing * difference / shared latency maximum
mappings.error: declared category selects a fixed fracture mask; unclassified failures use other
mappings.color: successful trace=ink, successful endpoint=verdigris, failed trace=oxide, missing=ink
mappings.missing: open diamond for missing outcome; metric-specific open markers for missing numeric channels
mappings.summary: observed-success ratio; medians exclude missing values; coverage reported explicitly
